Hey guys! So I've been watching your responses and trying to decide what the best way to go about this was. As of now, this is what I'm planning for the first jam's rules...

Frequency

Once every 2 months. Frequent enough to keep things fairly active, but not too often, so it's still a special event.

Duration

7 days. Not quite Ludum Dare short, but short enough to keep it exciting and create a sense of urgency.

Theme Selection

Community vote to narrow it down to 5, RNG to select final theme. You guys will still have input on the theme, while keeping the final theme a surprise.

Additional Rules

Other, more specific restrictions (eg. color palette limits), will be discussed and voted on in a separate thread prior to the event. The community also has the option to suggest no additional limits. Whatever the most upvoted suggestion is will be implemented (as long as it's reasonable). No restrictions will be put on use of engine, language, etc. The jam can be a challenge, but not inaccessible.

As for the actual date of the first jam, it's still up in the air. I'd like to continue to build the community a bit so we have a decent amount of participants, but I also don't want to put it off for too long, especially considering the jam itself will be a big draw to join the community.

All of these rules are still subject to change if the demand is there. If you have any questions, comments, or concerns, just let me know!
